description: Cenovnici proizvoda prema Pravilniku o uslovima sadržaju i načinu objavljivanja cenovnika - METRO is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Serbia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by METRO Cash&Carry doo Beograd. Ovaj skup sadrži podatke o cenama proizvoda koje trgovci dostavljaju u skladu sa Pravilnikom o uslovima, sadržaju i načinu objavljivanja cenovnika („Sl. glasnik RS”, br. 76/2026). Ističe se postojanje istorijskih odnosno mesečnih preseka cenovnika koji su važili prvog dana kalendarskog meseca, kao i poslednjih važećih cenovnika trgovaca. Coverage: METRO Cash&Carry doo Beograd. The publisher named on the listing is METRO Cash&Carry doo Beograd. Its keywords include cene. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data License - Serbian Open Data Portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-serbia.
